Jobs at the University of St Andrews

Recognised as one of the top universities in the UK and globally, the University of St Andrews is renowned for its high quality research and teaching and exceptional student experience.

As an employer, we are dedicated to attracting and retaining the best talent by providing a supportive and dynamic work environment. We believe in the power of collaboration, uniting academic and professional services teams as one community to create an exceptional atmosphere for learning and research.

Our commitment to our staff is outlined in our People Strategy, where we aim to provide a high-quality staff experience which enables all our staff to contribute, thrive and perform at their best.

We value equality. diversity and inclusion and have set ourselves an ambitious vision to make St Andrews a beacon of inclusivity, placing diversity and equality at the centre of everything we do and creating an environment in which all can flourish and realise their potential.

Why join us

University strategy 2022 to 2027

Great universities constantly move forward. They anticipate, lead, adapt, and are society’s engines of innovation and change. Momentum is everything.

When St Andrews flourishes, it does so because it combines a commitment to academic excellence with an inherent dynamism which moulds us to the challenges and opportunities of the age.
